raw:
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.effective_month = '2026-05' THEN h.population END) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN h.effective_month = '2026-04' THEN h.population END)
FROM main."country" c
JOIN main."country_history" h ON c."Code" = h.code
WHERE c."Continent" = 'Asia'
  AND h.authored = true;
